notes.title: About the seventh chapter
notes.notes: [p]Hi! There hasn't been any news for a long time, but to be honest, I tend to become inactive during the summer and don't have much to share. However, work is progressing, and I'm a little nervous about the outcome! The story is coming to an end, and I hope the upcoming finale won't disappoint. But all I can do is keep working and do everything I can.[/p][p]So, a little bit about chapter seven.[/p][list][*][p]Of course, a new outfit for Maria;[/p][/*][*][p]New background, or rather, Cole's personal location;[/p][/*][*][p]Alexander will return![/p][/*][*][p]A couple of new illustrations for fairy tales. These are the last ones;[/p][/*][*][p]New CGs, there are... 10? CGs are quite volatile, there can always be more at any moment. I have no control over that![/p][/*][/list][p]Overall, the chapter is almost ready. Some CG are difficult to produce, but once they are finished, the chapter will also be ready. [/p][p]Phew, we've come such a long way. This is the first project I've worked on that has taken so long. I want to finish it quickly and move on to something new, but I don't want to get distracted.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting the project and continuing to follow it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792636/ae82e6693b814364ae9c1e9868975be11a15469d.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Release chapter six!
About chapter six
Chapter five release!
notes.notes:
Hey, everybody!

Chapter five is finally released, and it was the most challenging of all, as it is divided into three paths.
What's new:

* 3 new CG;
* new BG;
* 4 new illustrations for fairytales;
* 3 new achievements;
* two new suits at the love interest's.

Now let's get to the list of changes:

* The map now has a skip button. It will not affect the gameplay, so if you don't want to explore the estate again, you can just skip it.

* Other characters have been added to the wardrobe! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792636/b7258de2ba75ebd4fb8b148c4236a89001312fc2.png[/img]

* Relationship Scale. You can now see your relationship progress. However, the stats do not show all possible relationships in the game. The progress button is located on the textbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792636/be9a68fce653dea1d0e4389ae1fe69bf29f22b5b.png[/img]

* Small visual adjustments that most likely no one will notice, but they are there~

Thank you so much for staying with us!

notes.title: About chapter five
Release of chapter four
notes.notes:
Hi!
Chapter four is finally out. Since I was previously busy with another project, the release was a bit delayed.
So, what's new:

* 7 new CG
* 2 new BG
* 2 new story illustrations
* 18к~ word

In the next chapter, the plot will develop more individually depending on the root chosen in the third chapter. There will also be a different chapter title for each character.

In news: a new project is planned, the page for which can be viewed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345700/_/]here[/url].

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi!
We have released a small update. We hope everything is working as it should!
What's new:
- The English version of the third chapter has been patched. There will probably be another patch on this early next year. For now, we're checking it out.
- Added the main character's closet. Yay! All costumes from the finished chapters are now available. The next ones will be unlocked as the game progresses. Right now there are two locked costumes.
- Added character profiles.
- The music in the main menu now starts more smoothly.
- A small fix for Daniel's sprite. Don't worry, only the collarbones are fixed =D

We congratulate you on the coming new year! We hope that in the new year we will please you with a new project! ^_^

notes.title: New release and about the fourth chapter
notes.notes:
Hi!
The project that has been clamoring for attention is finally finished: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268200/Espresso_For_The_Demon/]Espresso For The Demon[/url]
As for the fourth chapter of Bride Of Darkness, it will be released around February-March. This time there will be more focus on the division into routines, as well as plans to add a gallery of the heroine's outfits, as they are becoming very numerous.
More specific dates are likely to be announced in January.

notes.title: About the fourth chapter
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
I'm slowly increasing the text of the fourth chapter, new illustrations and a new costume for the main character (again, yep. I'll make a separate tab for them in the bonuses). But most of the time is taken up by a project that needs to be finished already this year [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268200/Espresso_For_The_Demon/]Espresso For The Demon[/url].
So as soon as this one is finished, I'll announce the timeline for the next chapter right away.

By the way, here's a new costume for Maria. She seems to have declared war on dresses from Victoria, but Victoria doesn't intend to give up so easily either and will always find a new one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792636/ff2bf6fb45b9e10857763c2e128a8407465e29cb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Chapter three release!
notes.notes:
Hi! 
Here it is, finally the release of the third chapter. Unfortunately, there were some difficulties that have nothing to do with the game, and the release was a bit delayed. 
This chapter is a transitional chapter and the last in the overall plot. Next, the heroine chooses with whom to spend more time and, accordingly, whose secrets to reveal.

As usual, dates for the next chapter will be announced at a later date.
Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Project News
notes.notes:
Hi! 
Summer is the time of vacations, unbearable heat and grand sales, so the time for release is, to put it mildly, not the best. As a result, it was decided to hold the chapter until the end of August, closer to the fall. Most of the material is already done, it just needs to be beautified. 
In addition, work continues on other projects such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268200/Espresso_For_The_Demon/]Espresso For The Demon[/url], which is also moving towards its completion.

notes.title: About Chapter Three
notes.notes:
Hi!

Enough time has passed since the second chapter, and we're getting to work on the next one.
The third chapter will be set in completely new locations, and the main characters will have new costumes and, accordingly, new CG.
There is a lot of work to be done, but the third chapter is scheduled for release in the summer. We'll decide on the month later.

As a bonus, a new costume for the MC: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792636/3c448e5006b21d716c23529afc7a1b354956a266.png[/img]
